nodes.summary: The data-fit term `D_1(V | W H) = ∑_{f,n} d(v_fn | (W H)_fn)`.
nodes.title: Data-fit term of the ARD-NMF objective

nodes.summary: The relevance never falls below its floor `b / c` (`W, H ≥ 0`, `c > 0`).
nodes.title: Lower bound on the relevance update

nodes.summary: The Kullback–Leibler `β = 1` divergence `d(x | y) = x log (x / y) - x + y` (Tan–Févotte, Eq. 4). With Mathlib's `0 * log _ = 0` it gives `d(0 | y) = y`, the correct value; `y > 0` is needed when `x > 0`.
nodes.title: Generalized Kullback–Leibler divergence

nodes.summary: The `H` update is monotone (Tan–Févotte 2013, §IV-B, `β = 1`): it does not increase `D_1(V | W H) / φ + ∑ h_kn / λ_k`, for `φ > 0`, `λ > 0`, `V ≥ 0`, `W ≥ 0` with no zero row, and `H > 0` entrywise.
nodes.title: The `H` update is monotone

nodes.summary: The `H`-dependent part `D_1(V | W H) / φ + ∑_{k,n} h_kn / λ_k` of the `ℓ₁`-ARD objective (Tan–Févotte, Eq. 20, `β = 1`).
nodes.title: H-dependent part of the ARD-NMF objective

nodes.summary: It does not increase `D_1(V | W H) / φ + ∑ w_fk / λ_k`, for `φ > 0`, `λ > 0`, `V ≥ 0`, `H ≥ 0` with no zero column, and `W > 0` entrywise (the transpose of `objectiveH_updateH_le`).
nodes.title: The `W` update is monotone

nodes.summary: The `W`-dependent part `D_1(V | W H) / φ + ∑_{f,k} w_fk / λ_k` of the `ℓ₁`-ARD objective (Tan–Févotte, Eq. 20, `β = 1`).
nodes.title: W-dependent part of the ARD-NMF objective
Reconstruction matrix in nonnegative matrix factorization

nodes.summary: Pruning (Tan–Févotte, §IV-D): the relevance equals its floor `b / c` exactly when the `k`-th column of `W` and the `k`-th row of `H` are zero (`W, H ≥ 0`, `c > 0`).
nodes.title: Pruning

nodes.summary: The relevance update is the exact minimizer (Tan–Févotte, §IV-C): for `A > 0` and `c > 0`, `λ ↦ A / λ + c log λ` attains its minimum over `λ > 0` at `λ = A / c`.
nodes.title: The relevance update is the exact minimizer

nodes.summary: If `λ > 0` does as well as `A / c`, then `λ = A / c`.
nodes.title: The minimizer is unique

nodes.summary: The relevance update `λ_k = (‖w_k‖₁ + ‖h_k‖₁ + b) / c` (Tan–Févotte, Eq. 33, `ℓ₁` prior; `c = F + N + a + 1`).
nodes.title: Relevance update in ARD-NMF

nodes.summary: The multiplicative update maps a zero entry of `H` to zero.
nodes.title: A pruned entry stays pruned

nodes.summary: The `ℓ₁`-ARD multiplicative update of `H` for `β = 1` (Tan–Févotte, Eq. 32, Algorithm 2): `h_kn ← h_kn (∑_f w_fk v_fn / (W H)_fn) / (∑_f w_fk + φ / λ_k)`.
nodes.title: ARD multiplicative update of H

nodes.summary: The multiplicative update maps a zero entry of `W` to zero.
nodes.title: A pruned entry stays pruned

nodes.summary: The `ℓ₁`-ARD multiplicative update of `W` for `β = 1` (Tan–Févotte, Algorithm 2): `w_fk ← w_fk (∑_n v_fn h_kn / (W H)_fn) / (∑_n h_kn + φ / λ_k)`.
nodes.title: ARD multiplicative update of W

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
